description: Defines a WishlistService class that interacts with a wishlist API endpoint, allowing listing, adding, and removing wishlist entries.

classes.name: WishlistService
classes.description: A singleton service class that provides methods to interact with the wishlist API endpoints, including listing, adding, and removing wishlist items.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of wishlist entries from the API.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a book to the wishlist by its ID.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a wishlist entry by its ID.
